1.consolidated_definition: Entre galleros, poner frente a frente dos gallos que han dejado de pelear por cansancio o por las heridas, para que continúen la pelea o para decidir cuál es el vencedor.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To pit two roosters against each other again, after they have ceased fighting due to exhaustion or injuries, in order for them to continue the fight or to determine which one is the winner.
